up: Return the exact activity values (standard_value and standard_units) and canonical SMILES for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1054501. For exact activity values, include only rows where activities.standard_relation is '=' and activities.standard_value is not NULL. Include the molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule pref_name, canonical SMILES, activity type (standard_type), standard value, and standard units. Return one row per activity.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054501'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
